INTEGRATED SCIENCE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #7
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrical Energy? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrical Energy.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Electrical Energy.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrical Energy.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrical Energy.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laboratory Safety? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Laboratory Safety.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laboratory Safety.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laboratory Safety.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laboratory Safety.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Human Excretory System? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Human Excretory System.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Human Excretory System.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Human Excretory System.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Excretory System.

5. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Overgrazing continuously

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Acids, Bases and Indicators? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Acids, Bases and Indicators.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Acids, Bases and Indicators.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Acids, Bases and Indicators.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Acids, Bases and Indicators.

7. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. A mixture of two liquids

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Human Reproductive System? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Human Reproductive System.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Human Reproductive System.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Human Reproductive System.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Reproductive System.

9. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 100 °C

10. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Paper burning to ash

11. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only carbon dioxide

12. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mixtures? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mixtures.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mixtures.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mixtures.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Mixtures.

14. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laboratory apparatus and instruments? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laboratory apparatus and instruments.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laboratory apparatus and instruments.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Laboratory apparatus and instruments.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laboratory apparatus and instruments.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn.

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Integrated Science? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Integrated Science.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Integrated Science.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Integrated Science.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Integrated Science.

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg.

19. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Producers
   D. Tertiary consumers

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Magnetism? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Magnetism.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Magnetism.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Magnetism.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Magnetism.

21. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. joule (J)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
22. In three clear sentences, explain Electrical Energy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Magnetism and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Integrated Science and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Laboratory Safety and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Laboratory apparatus and instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

27. In three clear sentences, explain Mixtures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

28. In three clear sentences, explain Acids, Bases and Indicators and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Human Reproductive System and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

31. In three clear sentences, explain Human Excretory System and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
